ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RT-4
Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District, symbols and indications as
shown on Map No. 17-H in the area bound by:

       West Greenleaf Avenue; a line 200.0 feet west of and parallel to North Paulina
       Street; the public alley next south of and parallel to West Greenleaf Avenue;
       the public alley next west of and parallel to North Paulina Street,

to those of a B3-3 Community Shopping District.



SECTION 2. Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
necessary relief pursuant to Section 17-13-1003 and 17-13-1101 of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is included.



SECTION 3. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ____________________________
                                                          Maria Hadden
                                                          Alderwoman, 49th Ward




Common Address:
1721 W. Greenleaf Avenue
